labels.POLLING_RATE_V2_TOOLTIP:
Adjust the frequency at which the device will report back to the PC. Higher frequencies increase overall responsiveness and reduce input latency, but consume more energy and reduce battery life (if applicable).
 
The list of available frequencies depend on  the connection type and operating system.
labels.WIRED_POLLING_RATE_V2_TOOLTIP:
Adjust the frequency at which the device will report back to the PC. Higher frequencies increase overall responsiveness and reduce input latency.
 
The list of available frequencies depend on the connection type and operating system.
labels.POLLING_RATE_DESC: The frequency (Hz) at which your device sends data to your computer.
labels.POLLING_RATE_MULTI_DEVICE_DOCK_LIMITED_M: Polling rate limited to 1,000 Hz — your Razer Mouse Dock Pro is paired to both your mouse and keyboard. Unpair the keyboard to restore up to 8,000 Hz.
labels.POLLING_RATE_DUAL_LINK_LIMITED: The maximum polling rate has been reduced because of limitations in the current connection type.
labels.POLLING_RATE_WARN: Higher polling rates will result in reduced battery life and higher CPU usage which may impact frame rates.
labels.POLLING_RATE_WARN_NOBATTERY: Higher polling rates will result in higher CPU usage, which may impact frame rates.

labels.POLLING_RATE_V2_TOOLTIP:
调整设备向电脑回送报告的频率。 如果频率更高，则整体响应速度更高、输入延迟更低，但同时，消耗的能量更多、电池续航时间更短（如果适用）。
 
可用的频率取决于连接类型和操作系统。
labels.WIRED_POLLING_RATE_V2_TOOLTIP:
调整设备向电脑回送报告的频率。更高的频率可提高整体响应速度并减少输入延迟。
 
可用频率列表取决于连接类型和操作系统。
labels.POLLING_RATE_DESC: 数据在一秒内的更新频率 (Hz)。
labels.POLLING_RATE_DUAL_LINK_LIMITED: 由于当前连接类型的限制，最大轮询率已经降低。
labels.POLLING_RATE_WARN: 轮询率越高，CPU 占用率越高，因此可能会影响帧率。
labels.POLLING_RATE_WARN_NOBATTERY: 更高的轮询率会导致更高的CPU使用率，从而可能影响帧率。
